function.name: religion_history_get_councils
function.description: Retrieves a list of major councils in a specified religion. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: religion_history_get_schisms

count.description: Number of top schisms to retrieve.

message.content:
The three most significant schisms in Christian history are:

| # | Schism | Approximate Date | Key Parties | Main Cause |
|---|--------|------------------|-------------|------------|
| 1 | **Great Schism (East–West Schism)** | 1054 CE | Eastern Orthodox Churches vs. Roman Catholic Church | Long‑standing theological, liturgical, and political differences (e.g., the Filioque clause, papal primacy, cultural divides). |
| 2 | **Protestant Reformation** | 1517–1648 CE | Various Protestant movements (Lutheran, Calvinist, Anglican, etc.) vs. Roman Catholic Church | Doctrinal disputes (e.g., justification by faith, authority of Scripture), corruption in the Church, and desire for ecclesiastical reform. |
| 3 | **East–West Schism of 1965 (also called the “Second East–West Schism” or “Modern Schism”)** | 1965 CE | Eastern Orthodox Churches vs. Roman Catholic Church (in the context of the Second Vatican Council) | Renewed emphasis on doctrinal differences, especially regarding the nature of the Holy Spirit, the role of the Pope, and liturgical practices. |

These three events represent the most profound and lasting divisions within Christianity, each reshaping the religious, cultural, and political landscapes of their times.
